item4/ground_truth.jsonl.description: Answer key over the FULL collected-source population: 152 (CVE, build) cases over 146 CVEs with a source snapshot, labelled from execution pairs and fix-commit patch signatures only

item4/input.jsonl.description: INPUT: 54 CVEs with the source/patch evidence available per CVE (tools/build_benchmark_inputs.py)

item4/manifest.json.description: How the GT was built: population, evidence mix, corroboration, and every exclusion with its reason (the CVEs evidence could not label)

item4/population.json.description: The 104 CVEs of the original certification-document population. RETIRED as the scored population — the headline figure is now measured over every collected-source CVE (see item4/manifest.json); kept for traceability

item4/predictions.json.description: The SUT output being scored: vex_judge_v2 --no-patch-gate. Pre-gate, because the patch gate reads the same authorities the GT does and the gated run is circular

item4/predictions_gated.json.description: vex_judge_v2 with the patch PRE-gate live, over the vulnerable build. The gate is separate from Q1-Q4, not one of them. Needed to score the full population alongside the patched verdicts; circular on the patch_verified cases, which the result records

item4/predictions_patched.json.description: vex_judge_v2 --build patched: the verdicts for the vendor's remediated releases (data/fixed_releases/). A patched build cannot be judged pre-gate - Q2 reads 'present' on 10 of 12, because a fix edits the vulnerable function rather than deleting it - so these come from the gate-live run

item4/result.json.description: HEADLINE scored run for item #4: vulnerable build, patch gate off - the largest scope whose answer key shares no oracle with the SUT

item4/result_allbuilds.json.description: Scored over BOTH builds with the gate live - the only scope that exercises not_affected - with its circularity disclosure

item4/result_independent.json.description: Scored over execution-verified evidence only: the one scope where the GT and the SUT share no oracle. Small by construction
